This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has been open for 4 days with no activity.
Unfortunately, our resources are limited and we can not always take the time to respond to requests about websites that are not popular enough. The issue will be closed if no further activity occurs.
Please note, that AdGuard Filters is an open-source project that is used by different content blockers and we welcome contributions. If you have some technical knowledge about how websites work, you are welcome to create a pull request following [these instructions](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://woodwardlg.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwoodwardlg.com%2F)

### Comment
> woodwardlg.com is being blocked by AdGuard DNS Default (resolves to sinkhole 94.140.14.33). The Non-filtering server 94.140.14.140 returns the correct IP 159.65.34.143, confirming this is a blocklist entry rather than a resolution issue.
> 
> This is the website of a law firm. It was compromised earlier this year and was correctly flagged at the time. It was fully remediated on 2026-07-09 and has been verified clean since: CMS core and plugin checksums verified, full webroot scanned for injected code and phishing content, and the original access vector closed.
> 
> Current state as of 2026-07-29: valid Let's Encrypt certificate, clean HTTP 200 responses, no malicious content served. Not listed on Spamhaus DBL, SURBL, URIBL, OpenPhish, or Phishing.Database.
> 
> The stale listing causes ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR for legitimate visitors, since browsers attempt a TLS handshake against the sinkhole address. Requesting review for removal.
> 



### Screenshots
<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/e0o6agkbaz48ow84kggskggo840k4okm7tw0n4lydc.png?nc=1)
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/ev789bd6cp44s8c8cc8808s0go4c08coxt80tcoo74.png?nc=1)
</details>

### System configuration

| Information | Value |
|-------------|-------|
AdGuard product: | AdGuard DNS
DNS setup: | Router
DNS server: | Default
System version: | `Debian 13 (Linux) — reproduced via dig; DNS-level block, OS-independent`
Browser: | Chrome

comment.body:
Additional context since filing:

Cloudflare has cleared this domain — both 1.1.1.2 and 1.1.1.3 now resolve it normally. Fortinet, Webroot/OpenText, alphaMountain and VIPRE reassessment requests have also been submitted, and the domain was never listed on Spamhaus DBL, SURBL, URIBL, OpenPhish or Phishing.Database.

AdGuard Default (94.140.14.14) still returns the sinkhole 94.140.14.33, while Non-filtering (94.140.14.140) returns the correct address 159.65.34.143.

The practical impact is that visitors on AdGuard DNS get ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR, since the browser attempts a TLS handshake against the sinkhole.

Cloudflare having already cleared is the strongest single line there. It's an independent provider reaching the opposite conclusion, and it's trivially verifiable.

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://cloudpub.ru/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcloudpub.ru%2F)

### Comment
> Здравствуйте!
> 
> Мы команда сервиса CloudPub (cloudpub.ru), провайдер HTTP/TCP-туннелей (функциональный аналог ngrok, localtunnel, Cloudflare Tunnel). Наши пользователи получают поддомены вида "tunnel-name".cloudpub.ru для публикации локальных сервисов в интернет.
> 
> Проблема
> 
> Периодически отдельные пользователи размещают на своих поддоменах фишинг или вредоносное ПО. Мы их оперативно блокируем, однако в вашей базе при этом отмечается apex-домен cloudpub.ru (или маска *.cloudpub.ru). В результате блокируются десятки тысяч добросовестных пользователей, а снятие блокировки занимает значительное время, поскольку далеко не все вендоры оперативно обновляют записи после устранения инцидента.
> 
> Что мы делаем со своей стороны
> 
> • Интеграция с API VirusTotal и другими репутационными и антифишинговыми сервисами: контент на поддоменах проверяется автоматически.
> • Автоматическая и ручная блокировка аккаунтов нарушителей с удалением туннеля.
> • Работающий abuse-канал: `support@cloudpub.ru,` реакция в течение 24 часов.
> • Верификация пользователей и рейт-лимиты на создание поддоменов.
> 
> Что мы просим
> 
> 1. Классифицировать cloudpub.ru как shared или multi-tenant инфраструктуру (аналогично ngrok.io, trycloudflare.com, serveo.net, loca.lt) и применять блокировку на уровне конкретного FQDN поддомена, а не apex-домена или wildcard.
> 2. Снять текущую блокировку с cloudpub.ru и всех поддоменов, по которым нет активных подтверждённых инцидентов.
> 3. По возможности уведомлять нас на `support@cloudpub.ru` при обнаружении вредоносного поддомена. Мы гарантируем реакцию и готовы подтверждать факт блокировки нарушителя.
> 
> Дополнительно: мы инициировали добавление cloudpub.ru в Public Suffix List, что формально закрепляет статус домена как границы между разными владельцами контента.
> 
> Готовы предоставить любую дополнительную информацию: логи, подтверждение принятых мер, контакты для прямой связи.
> 
> Спасибо за рассмотрение.

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

### Comment
> woodwardlg.com is being blocked by AdGuard DNS Default (resolves to sinkhole 94.140.14.33). The Non-filtering server 94.140.14.140 returns the correct IP 159.65.34.143, confirming this is a blocklist entry rather than a resolution issue.
> 
> This is the website of a law firm. It was compromised earlier this year and was correctly flagged at the time. It was fully remediated on 2026-07-09 and has been verified clean since: CMS core and plugin checksums verified, full webroot scanned for injected code and phishing content, and the original access vector closed.
> 
> Current state as of 2026-07-29: valid Let's Encrypt certificate, clean HTTP 200 responses, no malicious content served. Not listed on Spamhaus DBL, SURBL, URIBL, OpenPhish, or Phishing.Database.

> The stale listing causes ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR for legitimate visitors, since browsers attempt a TLS handshake against the sinkhole address. Requesting review for removal.
